### 1. GitHub Marketplace · score 27 · ready
Why here: Tin's GitHub App is how founders let Tin open pull requests (src/tin_lite/integrations.py:3754), and its public page github.com/apps/tin-computer exists with no description and no Marketplace listing. SEOCode (SEO fixes on pull requests, 7 installs) and ShipRelay App (release notes to user engagement, 6 installs) are listed.
Before you submit:
- Add a description to the GitHub App's public page; it reads "No description" today.
- Use https://github.com/tin-computer/tin/issues as the support URL, or add a support page on tin.computer. The only contact on the legal pages is hello@emotionmachine.ai, on another domain.
- List as a free plan. Paid Marketplace plans need 100 installs and a verified publisher organisation.
Submit at: https://github.com/marketplace/new
Review: GitHub reviews every new listing; no time stated.

### 2. Google Workspace Marketplace · score 2.67 · confirm
Why here: founders connect Gmail and Calendar so Tin can build the outreach shortlist and send approved campaigns (src/tin_lite/integrations.py:90). Mailmeteor (7M+ users), Right Inbox (20K+) and Leadliner AI (511) are listed for cold outreach.
Before you submit:
- Confirm the OAuth consent screen is verified for gmail.send and calendar.events.readonly. If it is not, start verification first; it needs a demo video.
- Confirm the annual third-party security assessment for gmail.readonly. Without it this is a project of weeks, not this week.
- Fix the privacy policy: it describes Google Workspace access as "limited document and calendar data", but Tin requests Gmail read and send. Name the Gmail scopes and what Tin does with them.
Submit at: https://developers.google.com/workspace/marketplace/how-to-publish
Review: after OAuth verification; time varies.
